column3: “the boards” renders “the frames (qerashim),” and “the duty of their loads” renders “the duty of their carrying.”
“the items he is to carry” renders “the articles of the duty of their carrying.”
“the commandment of the LORD” renders “the mouth of the LORD” (also in verses 41, 45 and 49).
“everyone by his serving or carrying” renders “a man, a man on his service and on his burden”; the last clause is terse, and the meaning is uncertain.
